patterns: Avengers: Doomsday first looks still own the feed: DiscussingFilm's 'New look at AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY' did 2,961,447 with 66,200 likes, Sam Wilson's revealed team lineup 2,000,849, and the Cyclops look 1,199,482 with 63,087 likes.

Exclusive first looks at animated and game-adjacent series travel furthest: MACCA & FRIENDS hit 6,246,467 (top post of the day), the MAGIC: THE GATHERING teaser 965,810, the 2D GARFIELD series 960,639 and the LILO & STITCH short 242,901.

Executives saying something bold gets shared: Tom Rothman pitching SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY for Best Picture did 1,095,900, and James Gunn's statement that no one from Skydance has seen MAN OF TOMORROW did 783,315 with 46,523 likes.

A number in the headline works: HOW TO ROB A BANK 'at 32% on Rotten Tomatoes, lowest-rated of Leitch's career' did 1,004,453; Rotten Tomatoes' own score and 'most popular show' posts (From S4 67,034; The Body 40,440) were its best of the day.
Release-week build-up for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping: the District 12 female tributes roundup did 2,139,143 on FilmUpdates, Elle Fanning's press look 323,158, the album 58,559.

Small accounts win on prompts and opinions: ATRightMovies' 'What would you rate STAR WARS: A NEW HOPE out of 10?' did 26,680 and 'greatest elevator scene' 25,473; CinemaTweets1's bold one-liner 'This Film Is Good Enough To Win Best Picture' was its best at 45,062; RottenTomatoes' 'From: Season 4 is the most popular show this week' led its day at 67,034.
narrative_synthesis: An Avengers-and-animation day: MACCA & FRIENDS' exclusive first look led the board at 6,246,467 views on DiscussingFilm, followed by the new AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY look (2,961,447) and FilmUpdates' Hunger Games District 12 tributes roundup (2,139,143). Bold executive quotes (Rothman's Best Picture pitch 1.10M, Gunn on Man of Tomorrow 783K) and a harsh score (How to Rob a Bank at 32%, 1.00M) filled out the top. RottenTomatoes joined the watchlist with 11 hits, best 67,034.
